keyFindings.description: cc73bbec removed the defer that stopped the intakes; a stop during joinRegistry's admission wait returns at :579-583 without stopIntakes, so buffered messages are not Nak'ed and the hold (whose token names this process's subject) stays for its 15 s TTL.

takeOver deletes the durable, then AddConsumer fails (timeout, cancelled ctx at stop, permission) or the process dies: the next attempt sees ErrConsumerNotFound and creates the wanted config, DeliverAll for the events durable, replaying up to 72 h of GitHub messages; the ack floor is lost.

admits never bounds a page's R by the fleet's max R: after a rollback (N+1 pages open, no N+1 process live) an N+1 page (3,2) and an N-1 page (1,1) are both writable; the N-1 page's y-prosemirror deletes the since-2 element the other writes.

directiveAttrs, typedBlockRefusal and parsedDomAttrs (markdown and HTML paste) accept a type, attribute or enum choice whose creatable_since is above the editor's version; socket updates get no server-side refuseUncreatable, so a paste creates an element older writable pages delete.

Rebuild from the latest saved version: an element this build does not know answers 400 INVALID_MARKDOWN (uploadedInput's %v drops ErrUnknownElement), and a stored element this build reads but may not create yet fails encodeDocumentTree's refuseUncreatable (empty fragment as held) as 500 INTERNAL.

Spec item 5 and its acceptance: the rule covers message bus messages; the README covers stream/consumer settings, subjects and transport but says nothing about envelope/payload members or new event kinds.

No Contract change census, though the change adds refusals and error codes at process boundaries (409 DOC_NEWER_CONTENT and close 4425 where DOC_SCHEMA/4409 answered before, the write-path refusal of not-yet-creatable elements, backfill-files' refusal while a live process has no bucket).

Says a build before the rule counts as having no bucket and no identity; a build with no server_processes row at all (legion-envoy-v19.0.0 stops at migration 0134) is invisible to Bucketless and to the active-identity rule. The closing paragraph omits the file store and embedder.

The no-route retry wait ignores the request's AbortSignal here and in envoy-client dispatch-http.ts:1068; an aborted request stays pending up to about 7 s.
